name: Tilty / gimbal delta
kinematics: three delta parallelograms plus roll-constrained two-axis gimbal and three coordinated tilt rods

kinematicModel.basis: Nominal design with 35 mm carrier radius and 120 mm rear lever; lower rail stops omit travel unusable above the bed with 4 degree rod elevation reserve. Six actuators, five tool degrees of freedom. No physical geometry or controller calibration.

boundsBasis: Design study display area, not verified workspace

outputs.reason: Mechanism study only; controller output is unimplemented.

validation: Nominal rigid kinematics only. Three tilt actuators must satisfy gimbal compatibility; forces, collisions, joint cones, drives and printing are unverified.
